spans.text: we hypothesized that males would perform better than females in regulating negative emotion. We further hypothesized that males and females might show different patterns of neural activations in emotion regulation.

description.value: A non-randomized, parallel-group, cross-sectional study comparing male and female participants during an emotion-regulation fMRI paradigm.

description.value: Functional images were motion corrected, co-registered to the co-planar anatomical image, normalized, interpolated to 4-mm isotropic voxels, and spatially smoothed.

spans.text: For each participant, the functional images were motion corrected and co-registered to the co-planar anatomical image. The T1 images were normalized to the standard SPM template, and the resulting transformation matrix was applied to the co-registered functional images. Such normalized functional images were interpolated to 4-mm isotropic voxels and spatially smoothed with a Gaussian filter with an 8-mm kernel.
